dialogues.jp:
さて、昼休みになったし、環の手料理でも食べ
に行くか。
dialogues.en:
It's lunchtime... and time to devour Tamaki's home-made
delicacies.
dialogues.text:
It's lunchtime... and time to devour Tamaki's home-made
delicacies.

dialogues.jp: 最近、巫女部もそれなりに忙しいみたいだ。
dialogues.en: She'd been really busy with the Miko Club recently.
dialogues.text: She'd been really busy with the Miko Club recently.

dialogues.jp: この間は五人だった部員が、さらにまた増えた。
dialogues.en:
When I last checked, it was 5 members strong, and apparently
more had joined since.
dialogues.text:
When I last checked, it was 5 members strong, and apparently
more had joined since.

dialogues.jp: 同好会が部になるのも、もう時間の問題だろう。
dialogues.en:
Despite it being an appreciation club, it was starting to
take up a lot of time.
dialogues.text:
Despite it being an appreciation club, it was starting to
take up a lot of time.

dialogues.jp: ……だけど、本当に環はすごいと思う。
dialogues.en: ...And that only made me admire her even more.
dialogues.text: ...And that only made me admire her even more.

dialogues.jp:
そんなに忙しいのに、俺の分の弁当はちゃんと
作ってきている。
dialogues.en:
Despite how busy she is, she still makes sure to serve up a
portion for me, every lunchtime.
dialogues.text:
Despite how busy she is, she still makes sure to serve up a
portion for me, every lunchtime.

dialogues.jp: それに、神社の務めもさぼってないみたいだし。
dialogues.en:
Not to mention, fitting that in along with her duties at the
shrine...
dialogues.text:
Not to mention, fitting that in along with her duties at the
shrine...

dialogues.jp: 朝だって、きちんと起きてるし……。
dialogues.en:
She probably wakes up early and precisely the right time
everyday...
dialogues.text:
She probably wakes up early and precisely the right time
everyday...

dialogues.jp: 俺、まだまだ、だな。
dialogues.en: I still have a long way to go.
dialogues.text: I still have a long way to go.

dialogues.jp:
環のこと、精神的な部分で支えてあげられれば
とは思ってるけど。
dialogues.en:
I have to be there as well, to support her and make sure she
has ease of mind through this period.
dialogues.text:
I have to be there as well, to support her and make sure she
has ease of mind through this period.

dialogues.jp: 教室を出て、中庭へ続く廊下を歩く。
dialogues.en:
I headed out of the classroom, and down the corridor leading
to the courtyard.
dialogues.text:
I headed out of the classroom, and down the corridor leading
to the courtyard.

dialogues.jp: そこには、えらく派手に張り紙がしてあった。
dialogues.en: I passed by a large and gaudy poster on the way.
dialogues.text: I passed by a large and gaudy poster on the way.

dialogues.jp: 『野球部、３回戦突破！　強豪天城学園を破る』
dialogues.en:
"Baseball Club Chalks Up Third Win! Champions Amagi Academy
Defeated!"
dialogues.text:
"Baseball Club Chalks Up Third Win! Champions Amagi Academy
Defeated!"

dialogues.jp: は、はあ？
dialogues.en: H, huh?
dialogues.text: H, huh?

dialogues.jp:
あの、必勝祈願を頼みに来た万年一回戦負けの
野球部が、３回戦突破？
dialogues.en:
That victory prayer... it was so strong as to help the
perennial whipping boys win 3 in a row?
dialogues.text:
That victory prayer... it was so strong as to help the
perennial whipping boys win 3 in a row?

dialogues.jp: こうなると、まぐれとも言えなくなってくる。
dialogues.en: It can't just be seen as a fluke anymore...
dialogues.text: It can't just be seen as a fluke anymore...

dialogues.jp: ううむ、環の祈りのたまものか？
dialogues.en: Hmm, was it really the prayer's work...?
dialogues.text: Hmm, was it really the prayer's work...?

dialogues.jp: にわかには信じがたいが、さすがにな……。
dialogues.en: It was hard to believe at first, but now...
dialogues.text: It was hard to believe at first, but now...

dialogues.jp:
これは、巫女部はもっとすごいことになるかも
しれないな……。
dialogues.en:
I wonder what other surprises are in store for the Miko Club
now...
dialogues.text:
I wonder what other surprises are in store for the Miko Club
now...

dialogues.jp: 放課後。
dialogues.en: After school.
dialogues.text: After school.

dialogues.jp:
巫女部の様子を見に行こうと、廊下へ出ると、
ちょうど環に出会う。
dialogues.en:
I thought about checking up on the Miko Club again, and saw
Tamaki on my way out of the classroom.
dialogues.text:
I thought about checking up on the Miko Club again, and saw
Tamaki on my way out of the classroom.

dialogues.jp: お、グッドタイミングだな。
dialogues.en: Ohh, good timing.
dialogues.text: Ohh, good timing.

dialogues.en: "Tamaki!"
dialogues.text: "Tamaki!"

dialogues.jp: 環の背中に声を掛ける。
dialogues.en: I called out to her back.
dialogues.text: I called out to her back.

dialogues.jp: 環が振り返り、俺に気づくと笑顔になる。
dialogues.en:
Tamaki turned around, and a smile grew instantly on her face
as she recognized me.
dialogues.text:
Tamaki turned around, and a smile grew instantly on her face
as she recognized me.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「あら、朝倉様」
dialogues.en: "My, Asakura-sama."
dialogues.text: "My, Asakura-sama."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「今から部活か？」
dialogues.en: "Are you doing club activities now?"
dialogues.text: "Are you doing club activities now?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「はい」
dialogues.en: "Yes, I am."
dialogues.text: "Yes, I am."

dialogues.jp: 環の手には、｛はら／祓｝い棒がたくさん抱えられている。
dialogues.en:
Tamaki was holding several of those poles meant for
purification.
dialogues.text:
Tamaki was holding several of those poles meant for
purification.

dialogues.jp: 「ちょっと貸せ。持ってやるよ」
dialogues.en: "Let me handle some of those."
dialogues.text: "Let me handle some of those."

dialogues.jp: 環の持ってる棒を、俺の手に移しかえる。
dialogues.en:
I gently shifted half of the poles she was holding onto
myself.
dialogues.text:
I gently shifted half of the poles she was holding onto
myself.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ああ、すいません。ありがとうございます」
dialogues.en: "Ah... thank you very much."
dialogues.text: "Ah... thank you very much."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「この棒、こんなにたくさんどうするんだ」
dialogues.en: "There's so many of them."
dialogues.text: "There's so many of them."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「全部、新入部員の分なんです」
dialogues.en: "They are all for the new members."
dialogues.text: "They are all for the new members."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「え？　こんなにたくさん」
dialogues.en: "Ehh? All these...?"
dialogues.text: "Ehh? All these...?"

dialogues.jp: 環はコクリと頷く。
dialogues.en: Tamaki nodded.
dialogues.text: Tamaki nodded.

dialogues.jp: 「一体、何人いるんだよ」
dialogues.en: "Just how many?"
dialogues.text: "Just how many?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「今日、また何人か入るんだと思うんですが、
　今のところ１５人ですね」
dialogues.en: "Assuming no one joins today, we have 15 members."
dialogues.text: "Assuming no one joins today, we have 15 members."

dialogues.en: 15 members!!
dialogues.text: 15 members!!

dialogues.jp: いつの間にそんなに増えたんだ。
dialogues.en: When did it grow that much?
dialogues.text: When did it grow that much?

dialogues.jp: 確かに、増えてきたとは聞いてたけど……。
dialogues.en: I knew the membership was increasing, but...
dialogues.text: I knew the membership was increasing, but...

dialogues.jp: 最初の頃を考えると、信じられない数だ。
dialogues.en:
Thinking back to the time where it first started, 15 was an
unbelievable number.
dialogues.text:
Thinking back to the time where it first started, 15 was an
unbelievable number.

dialogues.jp:
このままいけば『巫女娘。』も夢じゃなく、ユ
ニットに分裂してシャッフルもありか？
dialogues.en:
At this rate, not only is "Miko Musume" plausible, but even
splitting them into different groups...
dialogues.text:
At this rate, not only is "Miko Musume" plausible, but even
splitting them into different groups...

dialogues.jp:
一瞬、俺の中でプロデューサーのような考えが
浮かぶ。
dialogues.en: The producer in me started to plot.
dialogues.text: The producer in me started to plot.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「何か、巫女装束がブームらしくて……。それ
　に憧れて入ってくる人がほとんどですね」
dialogues.en:
"It seems the sales of Miko costumes have boomed... as well
as the people wanting to be one."
dialogues.text:
"It seems the sales of Miko costumes have boomed... as well
as the people wanting to be one."

dialogues.jp: ……そんなのアリか？
dialogues.en: ...It's gone that far?
dialogues.text: ...It's gone that far?

dialogues.jp: 神に仕える身なのに、その動機って……。
dialogues.en:
It's supposed to be to costume to show your servitude under
God...
dialogues.text:
It's supposed to be to costume to show your servitude under
God...

dialogues.jp: と、思えないことも無い。
dialogues.en: Well, I'm sure they understand.
dialogues.text: Well, I'm sure they understand.

dialogues.jp:
環は、どうやら、神道についての講義を行うら
しい。
dialogues.en:
Apparently, Tamaki was going to give them a lecture on the
way of the Shinto today.
dialogues.text:
Apparently, Tamaki was going to give them a lecture on the
way of the Shinto today.

dialogues.jp:
「なあ、俺も聞いてていい？　少しは興味ある
　し」
dialogues.en: "Is it okay if I listen in? I'm kinda interested."
dialogues.text: "Is it okay if I listen in? I'm kinda interested."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「もちろん、いいですよ。朝倉様に知ってもら
　えれば嬉しいですから」
dialogues.en:
"Most certainly. I would be happy to educate you on such
practices."
dialogues.text:
"Most certainly. I would be happy to educate you on such
practices."

dialogues.jp: と、環は笑って答える。
dialogues.en: She answered with big smile.
dialogues.text: She answered with big smile.

dialogues.jp: 「じゃあ、荷物を教室まで運んでやるよ」
dialogues.en: "Then let me handle the items."
dialogues.text: "Then let me handle the items."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「え？　いいんですか？」
dialogues.en: "Ah... are you sure?"
dialogues.text: "Ah... are you sure?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「だって、重いだろ？」
dialogues.en: "Isn't it heavy?"
dialogues.text: "Isn't it heavy?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ほれ、もっと貸してみな」
dialogues.en: "Then let me handle it."
dialogues.text: "Then let me handle it."

dialogues.jp:
俺は、環が持っていた残りの払い棒も持ってや
る。
dialogues.en: I took over the remaining ones that Tamaki was carrying.
dialogues.text: I took over the remaining ones that Tamaki was carrying.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ありがとうございます。助かります」
dialogues.en: "Thank you very much for your help."
dialogues.text: "Thank you very much for your help."

dialogues.jp: 俺達は教室へと向かった。
dialogues.en: We then went to the classroom.
dialogues.text: We then went to the classroom.

dialogues.jp:
しばらくすると、巫女同好会の部員達が、続々
と教室に入ってきた。
dialogues.en:
A short while later, the Miko Appreciation Club members
started entering continuously.
dialogues.text:
A short while later, the Miko Appreciation Club members
started entering continuously.

dialogues.jp: ちっ、今日は巫女装束じゃないのか。
dialogues.en: Tch, they're not wearing the costume today.
dialogues.text: Tch, they're not wearing the costume today.

dialogues.jp: 環も部員達も、みんな制服だ。
dialogues.en: All of them, including Tamaki, were in the school uniform.
dialogues.text: All of them, including Tamaki, were in the school uniform.

dialogues.jp: ちょっと期待していただけに、残念。
dialogues.en: My hopes were utterly dashed.
dialogues.text: My hopes were utterly dashed.

dialogues.jp: やはり、巫女は形からかも……。
dialogues.en: The figure of a Miko is really...
dialogues.text: The figure of a Miko is really...

dialogues.jp: 杉並は正しかったのか？
dialogues.en: Maybe Suginami was right?
dialogues.text: Maybe Suginami was right?

dialogues.jp: いや、違うだろう。
dialogues.en: No... no way.
dialogues.text: No... no way.

dialogues.jp:
俺は、自分の中に生まれた巫女装束への憧れを
消す。
dialogues.en:
I quickly destroyed the dream of wearing a Miko Costume
inside me.
dialogues.text:
I quickly destroyed the dream of wearing a Miko Costume
inside me.

dialogues.jp:
早速環は、さっき事務室でコピーしたプリント
を配る。
dialogues.en:
Tamaki was handing out the photocopies that she had made
earlier.
dialogues.text:
Tamaki was handing out the photocopies that she had made
earlier.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「足りないところはないでしょうか？」
dialogues.en: "Everyone has a copy?"
dialogues.text: "Everyone has a copy?"

dialogues.jp:
こうやって、教壇の上の環を見ると、一味違っ
ていて新鮮だ。
dialogues.en:
The way she stands on that platform, it's hard to tell that
she's new at it.
dialogues.text:
The way she stands on that platform, it's hard to tell that
she's new at it.

dialogues.jp: ……先生みたいに見えなくもない。
dialogues.en: ...She could easily be a teacher in the future.
dialogues.text: ...She could easily be a teacher in the future.

dialogues.jp:
教室の部員達に目を移すと、みんな真剣な表情
でプリントを見ている。
dialogues.en:
Everyone else in the classroom were dutifully reading the
printouts given to them.
dialogues.text:
Everyone else in the classroom were dutifully reading the
printouts given to them.

dialogues.jp:
巫女装束に興味のあるやつらばかりだって聞い
てたけど、意外にやる気あるのかもな。
dialogues.en:
It still seems uncertain whether all these people have
hidden agendas for joining, though...
dialogues.text:
It still seems uncertain whether all these people have
hidden agendas for joining, though...

dialogues.jp:
環は、全員が話を聞く体勢になったことを確認
すると、
dialogues.en: Tamaki, affirming that everyone was able to hear her,
dialogues.text: Tamaki, affirming that everyone was able to hear her,

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「では、早速始めます。神道とは……」
dialogues.en: "Then, I shall begin. Shinto is..."
dialogues.text: "Then, I shall begin. Shinto is..."

dialogues.jp: 説明を始めた。
dialogues.en: Her explanation began.
dialogues.text: Her explanation began.

dialogues.jp: 一生懸命だな……。
dialogues.en: She was giving it her all...
dialogues.text: She was giving it her all...

dialogues.jp:
分かりやすい言葉で、真剣に説明している。環
は、どんなことにも何時も、真剣だ。
dialogues.en:
Using easy-to-understand words and explanations, yet
explaining seriously. She always is, anyway.
dialogues.text:
Using easy-to-understand words and explanations, yet
explaining seriously. She always is, anyway.

dialogues.jp: 俺のように、半端なヤツとは違う。
dialogues.en:
Unlike myself, who's always being a lazy smartass half the
time.
dialogues.text:
Unlike myself, who's always being a lazy smartass half the
time.

dialogues.jp: 授業にも、神社も、部活も、多分、恋愛も……。
dialogues.en:
Whether it's at a lesson, at a shrine, at club activities,
and probably even at love...
dialogues.text:
Whether it's at a lesson, at a shrine, at club activities,
and probably even at love...

dialogues.jp:
できれば、今日来ている部員達も、そのことを
受け止めてくれればいいけど。
dialogues.en:
I should mimic the rest of the club members here, and stop
that behaviour, but...
dialogues.text:
I should mimic the rest of the club members here, and stop
that behaviour, but...

dialogues.jp: まあ、無理な話だろう。
dialogues.en: Nah, too much bother.
dialogues.text: Nah, too much bother.

dialogues.jp:
俺は環を見ながら、愛しさがこみ上げてくるの
を感じる。
dialogues.en:
I just stared at Tamaki, letting my feelings of love for her
overcome me.
dialogues.text:
I just stared at Tamaki, letting my feelings of love for her
overcome me.

dialogues.jp: しかし、
dialogues.en: However,
dialogues.text: However,

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「巫女は、身も心も精錬潔白でなくてはなりま
　せん」
dialogues.en:
"A Miko must be the picture of purity, in both mind and
body."
dialogues.text:
"A Miko must be the picture of purity, in both mind and
body."

dialogues.jp: という言葉に、俺はドキリとする。
dialogues.en:
She cannot associate with others, and must live a life of
purity.
dialogues.text:
She cannot associate with others, and must live a life of
purity.

dialogues.jp:
本来の巫女とは、神をその身体に降ろすものだ
と聞いている。
dialogues.en:
I hadn't realized it till now... but Tamaki's supposed to be
one of those people too.
dialogues.text:
I hadn't realized it till now... but Tamaki's supposed to be
one of those people too.

dialogues.jp:
他のものが混ざっていない、純粋な存在、それ
が巫女の条件、だと聞いている。
dialogues.en: But we have been dating... and those things...
dialogues.text: But we have been dating... and those things...

dialogues.jp:
今まで、あまり気にはしなかったけれど、環は
神さまに仕えているのだ。
dialogues.en:
The meaning of "purity" can be argued, but there's no
dispute that her virginity is no longer hers.
dialogues.text:
The meaning of "purity" can be argued, but there's no
dispute that her virginity is no longer hers.

dialogues.jp: けれど、俺と環は付き合っている。
dialogues.en: Her body and soul is supposed to be God's, but her heart...
dialogues.text: Her body and soul is supposed to be God's, but her heart...

dialogues.jp: 一瞬、イヤな考えが頭をよぎる。
dialogues.en: A horrible thought entered my head.
dialogues.text: A horrible thought entered my head.

dialogues.jp:
それに追い討ちを掛けるように、一人の新入部
員が質問をする。
dialogues.en:
As if delivering the final blow, one of the new members
raised a question.
dialogues.text:
As if delivering the final blow, one of the new members
raised a question.

dialogues.speaker: Female Student 1
dialogues.jp:
「では、巫女は恋をしてはいけないということ
　ですか？」
dialogues.en: "Does that mean Miko cannot fall in love?"
dialogues.text: "Does that mean Miko cannot fall in love?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.en: "Ehh?"
dialogues.text: "Ehh?"

dialogues.jp: 環はその言葉に詰まっている。
dialogues.en: The question stopped her in her tracks.
dialogues.text: The question stopped her in her tracks.

dialogues.jp:
｛さすが／流石｝に、環もその質問には動揺を隠せないみた
いだ。
dialogues.en: Her discomfort at the question was clear for all to see.
dialogues.text: Her discomfort at the question was clear for all to see.

dialogues.jp: 女子学生は、射るような目で環を捉える。
dialogues.en: The female students all focused intently on Tamaki.
dialogues.text: The female students all focused intently on Tamaki.

dialogues.jp: 環は、教室にいる俺の方をチラリと見た。
dialogues.en: Her eyes fell upon me for a split second.
dialogues.text: Her eyes fell upon me for a split second.

dialogues.jp: ごめん、環。
dialogues.en: I'm sorry, Tamaki.
dialogues.text: I'm sorry, Tamaki.

dialogues.jp: 俺には答えられない……。
dialogues.en: I cannot answer that...
dialogues.text: I cannot answer that...

dialogues.jp: 環はそこで、黙ってしまっている。
dialogues.en: Tamaki stayed stock still and quiet.
dialogues.text: Tamaki stayed stock still and quiet.

dialogues.speaker: Female Student 2
dialogues.jp: 「えー、恋愛はダメなの？」
dialogues.en: "Ehhh~, love is forbidden?"
dialogues.text: "Ehhh~, love is forbidden?"

dialogues.speaker: Female Student 3
dialogues.jp: 「あたし、彼氏いるんだけど……」
dialogues.en: "But I have a boyfriend..."
dialogues.text: "But I have a boyfriend..."

dialogues.jp:
答えられない環を見て、それまで静かに話を聞
いていた部員達は、一斉にざわつき始めた。
dialogues.en:
Seeing Tamaki's reticience, the quiet club members suddenly
broke out in heated discussion.
dialogues.text:
Seeing Tamaki's reticience, the quiet club members suddenly
broke out in heated discussion.

dialogues.jp: 環は、教卓の前で取り残されてしまっている。
dialogues.en:
Tamaki was left behind on the conversation, at the teacher's
desk.
dialogues.text:
Tamaki was left behind on the conversation, at the teacher's
desk.

dialogues.jp:
何か、答えたいとは思っているみたいだが、明
らかに当惑しているのは隠せない。
dialogues.en:
She seemed to be thinking of answering, but the shock was
still overcoming her.
dialogues.text:
She seemed to be thinking of answering, but the shock was
still overcoming her.

dialogues.jp: 考えてみれば、みんなが騒ぐ気持ちもわかる。
dialogues.en:
Thinking about it, it's not surprising that everyone was
worried.
dialogues.text:
Thinking about it, it's not surprising that everyone was
worried.

dialogues.jp: 女の子達にとって、恋は大切なことだ。
dialogues.en: Love is a very important thing for females.
dialogues.text: Love is a very important thing for females.

dialogues.jp:
恋をしていない女の子なんて、毎日がつまらな
いとさえ思ってるだろう。
dialogues.en:
To them, a girl not in love is one who just passes
day-by-day boringly.
dialogues.text:
To them, a girl not in love is one who just passes
day-by-day boringly.

dialogues.jp:
巫女になるためには、恋をしてはいけないとい
うのならば、これは由々しき問題だ。
dialogues.en:
If they had to forsake love to become a Miko... that'd be a
grave problem for them.
dialogues.text:
If they had to forsake love to become a Miko... that'd be a
grave problem for them.

dialogues.jp:
もちろん、全員が本格の巫女になるわけではな
いから、それほど大変なものではないけれど、
dialogues.en:
Of course, none of them truly want to be Miko, so it
wouldn't be a huge thing...
dialogues.text:
Of course, none of them truly want to be Miko, so it
wouldn't be a huge thing...

dialogues.jp:
いかに巫女服に憧れて入部したとはいえ、出鼻
をくじかれたも同然だ。
dialogues.en:
Most of them just seem interested in how good the uniform
looks on the.
dialogues.text:
Most of them just seem interested in how good the uniform
looks on the.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「そ、それは……」
dialogues.en: "T, that's..."
dialogues.text: "T, that's..."

dialogues.jp: 環は何とか答えを探そうとしている。
dialogues.en: Tamaki was desperately searching for an answer.
dialogues.text: Tamaki was desperately searching for an answer.

dialogues.jp: でも、詰まるのは無理もない。
dialogues.en: She was still at a loss for words.
dialogues.text: She was still at a loss for words.

dialogues.jp:
恋をしてはいけないことを肯定すれば、俺との
関係を否定することになる。
dialogues.en:
If she agreed with the girl's assessment, she'd be denying
her relationship with me.
dialogues.text:
If she agreed with the girl's assessment, she'd be denying
her relationship with me.

dialogues.jp:
逆に、恋を肯定すれば、巫女としては問題があ
る。
dialogues.en:
On the other hand, if she disagrees, then there's the
problem of her being a Miko.
dialogues.text:
On the other hand, if she disagrees, then there's the
problem of her being a Miko.

dialogues.jp: 答えなんて、そうそう出るものじゃあない。
dialogues.en:
No matter what she answered, she'd be put in a difficult
position.
dialogues.text:
No matter what she answered, she'd be put in a difficult
position.

dialogues.jp: ここは一つ、俺の出番か……。
dialogues.en: I should help her out...
dialogues.text: I should help her out...

dialogues.jp: でも、どうやって？
dialogues.en: But how?
dialogues.text: But how?

dialogues.jp: 部外者の俺が、何を言えばいいんだろう？
dialogues.en:
I'm not even a member of this club, what can I say to calm
them down?
dialogues.text:
I'm not even a member of this club, what can I say to calm
them down?

dialogues.jp:
結局、今、誤魔化したところで、いつかは、はっ
きりさせなければならならないだろう。
dialogues.en:
If I try to bluff them, it'd probably just bite me back
later.
dialogues.text:
If I try to bluff them, it'd probably just bite me back
later.

dialogues.jp: さっそく手詰まりか……。
dialogues.en: I was rendered completely helpless too.
dialogues.text: I was rendered completely helpless too.

dialogues.jp: そのとき。
dialogues.en: Just then,
dialogues.text: Just then,

dialogues.jp: ──ガラッ。
dialogues.en: *bang*
dialogues.text: *bang*

dialogues.jp: 教室の扉が開く音がした。
dialogues.en: The classroom door was opened wildly.
dialogues.text: The classroom door was opened wildly.

dialogues.jp: 部員達の視線は、一斉に扉へ向く。
dialogues.en: The entire class immediately looked in that direction.
dialogues.text: The entire class immediately looked in that direction.

dialogues.jp:
見ると、男子学生が立っている。バレー部のユ
ニフォームを着ている。
dialogues.en:
A male student was standing there, wearing the uniform of
the volleyball club.
dialogues.text:
A male student was standing there, wearing the uniform of
the volleyball club.

dialogues.speaker: Male Student
dialogues.jp:
「すみません。あの、うちも必勝祈願をお願い
　したいのですが……」
dialogues.en:
"Excuse me, um, I was wondering if you could... that victory
prayer..."
dialogues.text:
"Excuse me, um, I was wondering if you could... that victory
prayer..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「あ、はい」
dialogues.en: "Ah, yes!"
dialogues.text: "Ah, yes!"

dialogues.jp:
環は教室の扉の方へ行き、男子学生と話し始め
る。
dialogues.en:
Tamaki immedaitely headed to the hallway and began
discussing with the male student.
dialogues.text:
Tamaki immedaitely headed to the hallway and began
discussing with the male student.

dialogues.jp: ひとまず、質問の答えは中断だな。
dialogues.en: For the moment, the question seemed to have been delayed.
dialogues.text: For the moment, the question seemed to have been delayed.

dialogues.jp:
正直、俺は、答え想像できなかった。どんな答
えも、環を苦しめる気がしたから……。
dialogues.en:
Honestly, I couldn't imagine how she'd answer anyway. Either
way, she'd be pained...
dialogues.text:
Honestly, I couldn't imagine how she'd answer anyway. Either
way, she'd be pained...

dialogues.jp: いつまでも、逃げてちゃいけないんだけどな。
dialogues.en: But she can't run away from it forever, either.
dialogues.text: But she can't run away from it forever, either.

dialogues.jp: 環が教壇に戻る。
dialogues.en: Eventually, Tamaki returned to the platform.
dialogues.text: Eventually, Tamaki returned to the platform.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「ごめんなさい。これから必勝祈願をしますの
　で、見学する方は、一緒に来て下さい」
dialogues.en:
"My apologies, I shall be conducting a victory prayer. Those
who wish to observe, please come with me."
dialogues.text:
"My apologies, I shall be conducting a victory prayer. Those
who wish to observe, please come with me."

dialogues.jp: と、急いで荷物をまとめている。
dialogues.en: With that, she put the matter to rest.
dialogues.text: With that, she put the matter to rest.

dialogues.jp: そして、早足で教室を出て行ってしまった。
dialogues.en: And unsurprisingly, made a speedy exit from the classroom.
dialogues.text: And unsurprisingly, made a speedy exit from the classroom.

dialogues.jp: 部員達も、ガタガタと身支度を始める。
dialogues.en:
The clamour and chatter immediately began within the
classroom.
dialogues.text:
The clamour and chatter immediately began within the
classroom.

dialogues.jp:
その中で、部員たちが噂しているのが聞こえて
くる。
dialogues.en: I couldn't help but overhear some of the conversing.
dialogues.text: I couldn't help but overhear some of the conversing.

dialogues.speaker: Female Student 1
dialogues.jp:
「やっぱさぁ、巫女部にいる以上、恋愛はダメ
　なのかな？」
dialogues.en:
"So basically, if we're in the Miko Club, we can't be in
love?"
dialogues.text:
"So basically, if we're in the Miko Club, we can't be in
love?"

dialogues.speaker: Female Student 2
dialogues.jp: 「さあ。部長、言葉に詰まってたけど」
dialogues.en: "Maybe... the head was stunned by that question."
dialogues.text: "Maybe... the head was stunned by that question."

dialogues.speaker: Female Student 3
dialogues.jp:
「実際のところ、どうなんだろうね。そうだっ
　たら、ちょっとヤバイよね」
dialogues.en: "It'd get ugly for me if that was really the case..."
dialogues.text: "It'd get ugly for me if that was really the case..."

dialogues.jp:
彼女たちは、ヒソヒソと｛ささや／囁｝きあっていたが、俺
の方にはよく聞こえていた。
dialogues.en: They were whispering, but loud enough for me to hear.
dialogues.text: They were whispering, but loud enough for me to hear.

dialogues.jp:
そして、環と部員達は、バレー部の必勝祈願の
ために、部室を出て行くのだった。
dialogues.en:
Soon after, the rest of the club members went out to see
Tamaki perform the victory prayer.
dialogues.text:
Soon after, the rest of the club members went out to see
Tamaki perform the victory prayer.

dialogues.jp:
俺は、それを後ろから、椅子に座ってただ眺め
ているだけだった。
dialogues.en: I was left there, taking everything in.
dialogues.text: I was left there, taking everything in.

dialogues.jp: ◆巫女とは……◆
dialogues.en: ?櫪iko And...?・
dialogues.text: ?櫪iko And...?・

dialogues.jp:
環が、１５人にまで増えた新入部員を集めて、
神道についての講義をすることになった。
dialogues.en:
Tamaki was giving the 15-strong club members a lecture on
Shinto.
dialogues.text:
Tamaki was giving the 15-strong club members a lecture on
Shinto.

dialogues.jp:
環は、そこで巫女の心構えとして『身も心もき
れいでなくてはならない』と話す。
dialogues.en:
Tamaki took pains to emphasize that Miko must be pure of
body and soul.
dialogues.text:
Tamaki took pains to emphasize that Miko must be pure of
body and soul.

dialogues.jp:
そのとたん、部員達からは『巫女は恋をしては
いけないのか』という質問が飛んできた。
dialogues.en:
The club members then asked whether that meant that Miko
cannot fall in love.
dialogues.text:
The club members then asked whether that meant that Miko
cannot fall in love.

dialogues.jp:
言葉に詰る環。タイミングよく現われたバレー
部によって、その質問に答える機会を逸してし
まった。
dialogues.en:
The question shcoked Tamaki. Thanks to the good timing of
the Volleyball Club, she was able to avoid it.
dialogues.text:
The question shcoked Tamaki. Thanks to the good timing of
the Volleyball Club, she was able to avoid it.

dialogues.jp: 環はなんと答えるつもりだったのだろう。
dialogues.en: How would she plan to answer it...
dialogues.text: How would she plan to answer it...
